updates.releaseTitle: Audit Closeout — Lazy Chunks + Signed Releases + Local-First Logging

changelog.title: 67 modal-shaped feature surfaces moved behind React.lazy()
changelog.description: App.jsx no longer eager-imports the entire tool catalog. Each feature surface (PrivacyPolicy, MyPacket, CAPSimulator, NexusBuilder, AICommandCenter, PACTActNavigator, …) is its own vite chunk fetched on first open. Main entry: 196 KB gz. Modal cluster wrapped in a single <Suspense fallback={<LoadingBunker />}> boundary. Closes audit rows #23 + #28.

changelog.title: Sigstore keyless cosign + SLSA-3 provenance on every release
changelog.description: .github/workflows/release.yml now signs SBOMs + dist.tar.gz with cosign (GitHub OIDC, no key storage) and emits a SLSA Level 3 provenance attestation via the pinned slsa-github-generator@v2.0.0 reusable workflow. Verification recipes in docs/SUPPLY_CHAIN.md. Closes audit rows #20 + #21.

changelog.title: Local-first structured logger (zero-knowledge friendly)
changelog.description: src/utils/logger.js: debug/info/warn/error levels, 500-entry FIFO ring buffer, dev console passthrough, opt-in IndexedDB persistence (vet_rate_log_persist localStorage flag), single exportLogs() egress. No OTel/Sentry/Datadog — those rejections are explained in docs/OBSERVABILITY.md. Closes audit row #38.

changelog.title: Diátaxis categorical doc index
changelog.description: docs/DOCS_INDEX.md places every engineering doc in one of four quadrants (Tutorials, How-to, Reference, Explanation) with a one-line hook. Veteran-facing manual at docs/index.md stays separate. Closes audit row #37.

updates.releaseTitle: Best-Practices Audit Complete — Legal-RAG + Supply-Chain Hardening

changelog.title: Legal-RAG runtime over 38 CFR Part 4
changelog.description: New legalRag.js + legalAnswerer.js services with dual-LLM split (extractor → JSON facts → synthesizer) and LegalCitation badges that link to canonical .gov sources with fetched_at currency dates.

changelog.title: Weekly legal-index ingestion cron
changelog.description: GitHub Action refreshes the legal-index every Monday, opens a PR on content diff, and files a stale-source issue on fetcher failure. External-truth registry at knowledge-sources.yaml.

changelog.title: Zero npm audit vulnerabilities + SBOM on release
changelog.description: protobufjs and @xmldom/xmldom advisories resolved via npm overrides. Release tag now generates CycloneDX + SPDX SBOMs and attaches them to the GitHub Release.

changelog.title: CI security gates flipped to blocking
changelog.description: npm audit (prod, ≥high) and semgrep SAST (--strict) now block CI. Preflight contract enforcement defaults to STRICT_AUDIT=true.

changelog.title: Documentation & Stats Sync
changelog.description: Updated all project stats, documentation, legal pages, and user manual to match current codebase

updates.releaseTitle: BVA Intelligence Suite - Appeals Powered by Real Data

changelog.title: Nexus Quality Analyzer
changelog.description: Score your nexus letter like a BVA judge - based on analysis of 18,609 real BVA decisions. Private IMOs win 81.3% vs VA exams at 31.2%

changelog.title: Remand Risk Checker
changelog.description: Pre-submission gap finder with 8-point evidence checklist - catch what the VA will catch BEFORE you file

changelog.title: Appeals Lane Advisor
changelog.description: Interactive decision tree: Supplemental vs HLR vs Board. Real timeline data (46 vs 89 vs 547 days) helps you pick the right path

changelog.title: VA Data Collection Pipeline
changelog.description: New Python scrapers pull directly from BVA decision database, VA workload reports, and VA Open Data Portal - no more relying on third parties

changelog.title: Push-Prep VA Data Integration
changelog.description: VA data pipeline now runs automatically during push-prep - frontend data stays fresh with latest BVA statistics

changelog.title: Florence-2 Vision AI for DD214
changelog.description: Vision AI now the PRIMARY extraction method for DD214s - falls back to OCR only when needed. 3x more accurate on poor scans

updates.releaseTitle: Document Intelligence Suite - VA Claim Automation

changelog.title: VA Document Parser
changelog.description: Intelligent extraction from Decision Letters, C&P Exams, Code Sheets, BVA Decisions, and SOCs - finds conditions, ratings, and denial reasons automatically

changelog.title: C-File Segmentation
changelog.description: Burst your monster C-File into usable segments - backwards search finds Code Sheet first, then bursts into individual documents for targeted analysis

changelog.title: Evidence Gap Finder
changelog.description: Compares Decision Letter evidence vs C-File contents - flags Duty to Assist errors with legal citations (38 CFR § 3.159)

changelog.title: Adversarial Drafting
changelog.description: Auto-generates NOD/HLR arguments from evidence gaps - ready-to-use legal templates with case law citations (McLendon, Barr, Gabrielson)

changelog.title: VKB Document Integration
changelog.description: All extracted data flows into Evidence Timeline, Conditions Map, and Veteran Profile - builds your complete claim intelligence picture

changelog.title: Military-Style DROP ZONE
changelog.description: Muster Call drop zone now features targeting markers, amber styling, and clear privacy messaging - 100% on your device

changelog.title: Enhanced Privacy Messaging
changelog.description: DROP ZONE now prominently displays that documents never leave your device - all processing is 100% client-side

changelog.title: Warrant Council Integration
changelog.description: Three specialized AI agents fine-tuned on VA claims: Auditor (legal analysis), Writer (statement generation), and Rater (disability assessment)

changelog.title: Smart AI Loader
changelog.description: One-click device-aware model loading - automatically selects best model for your hardware

changelog.title: OCR-First Workflow
changelog.description: DD214 Analyzer now uses reliable OCR extraction before AI analysis - more accurate data extraction for all document types

changelog.title: Streamlined Model Selection
changelog.description: Removed experimental vision models to focus on stable, production-ready text models (Llama, Phi, Qwen, DeepSeek)

changelog.title: Cleaner Settings Interface
changelog.description: Simplified WebGPU configuration - removed experimental toggles for a more intuitive setup experience
